Minutes and Agendas

West Arnhem Regional Council holds Ordinary Council Meetings every month, alternating between in-person and video-conferencing. Special Council Meetings of Council are held as required.

Local Authority Meetings are convened four times per year for each of the four Local Authorities in the region.

All meeting dates appear on the calendar.

All meetings are open to the public and presenters are welcome.
